Solid wood crib, side drops down for easy access
Listed 1 week ago · Lisle, IL
Seller's description
Older crib but sturdy. The front side slides down so it's easy to lift baby out. Mattress not included.
Photo: U.S. CPSC recall notice #10046
identify.what_i_see: A wooden crib with a drop-side mechanism. The front side is shown in a lowered position, with a doll positioned as if trapped between the side rail and the mattress support. Red arrows and text labels point to the 'Upside-Down Drop-Side' and a 'Broken Claw' mechanism. The listing text confirms the side slides down and the mattress is not included.

verdict.summary: This is a U.S. solid wood crib with a drop-side design. The verdict is "Don't buy" because drop-side cribs cannot be legally resold under federal standards (16 CFR 1219/1220) since June 28, 2011, even if the side has been immobilized.
verdict.seller_message: Hi, thanks for listing this crib. I wanted to let you know that drop-side cribs can't be resold under current federal safety standards (16 CFR 1219/1220). Since this one has a drop side, I'll have to pass. Best of luck!
verdict.safer_alternative: Look for a fixed-side crib manufactured after June 2011 that meets current CPSC standards and includes all original parts and instructions.
